items.evidence_text: CALL TO ORDER
items.title: Call to Order

items.evidence_text:
1. Approve a proclamation honoring Commissioner Margaret Gómez for her 
extraordinary service to Travis County. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve proclamation honoring Commissioner Margaret Gómez

items.evidence_text: 2. Approve payment of claims by the County Treasurer. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve payment of claims by County Treasurer

items.evidence_text:
3. Consider and take appropriate action regarding the following: 
    
  A. Outdoor burning in the unincorporated areas of Travis County 
  B. County response to natural disaster or other emergencies, including but 
not limited to necessary measures and actions related to Travis County’s 
response, operations, policies, emergency assistance, agreements, and 
measures necessary to preserve public health and safety and 
rehabilitation of property, and applicable orders, declarations or 
resolutions, and authorization for expenditure of funds and contracts 
related to disaster response and recovery efforts 
(Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider action on outdoor burning and emergency response

items.evidence_text:
4. Consider and take appropriate action to approve the Consent by Lien Holder, for 
Travis County Facilities Corporation, a Texas public facility corporation, to grant 
an electric utility easement to the City of Austin, on that property being described 
as 11.58 acres, more or less, consisting of that certain parcel stated to contain 
6.60 acres, more or less, and that certain parcel stated to contain 4.98 acres, 
more or less, being a portion of Outlot 28 and Outlot 31, Division A, Government 
Outlots adjoining the original City of Austin, and being a portion of Lot 1, 
Siegmund Addition, Section Four, a subdivision of Travis County, Texas; and is 
the same property which received legal lot status in City of Austin Case C81-
2026-0137 attached to the Electric Utility Easement, being the same property 
described in that certain Special Warranty Deed recorded in Document No. 
2024130246. (Commissioner Howard)
items.title: Approve Consent by Lien Holder for electric utility easement to City of Austin

items.evidence_text:
5. Consider and take appropriate action to approve an amendment to the 
Community Development Block Grant COVID-19 (“CDBG-CV”) Response 
Project subrecipient agreement for the Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center 
(“SUN”) – Sunrise Homeless Response Initiative. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve amendment to CDBG-CV subrecipient agreement for Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center

items.evidence_text:
6. Consider and take appropriate action to approve modification to Interlocal 
Agreement No. 4600001072 with Worksource – Greater Austin Area Workforce 
Board DBA Workforce Solutions – Capital Area Workforce Board, for the 
provision of Child Care Scholarships (Judge Brown & Commissioner Shea).
items.title: Approve modification to Interlocal Agreement 4600001072 for Child Care Scholarships

items.evidence_text:
7. Consider and take appropriate action to approve modification to Interlocal 
Agreement No. 4600001073 with Worksource – Greater Austin Area Workforce 
Board DBA Workforce Solutions – Capital Area Workforce Board, for the 
provision of Child Care Gap Funding Payments Program . (Judge Brown & 
Commissioner Shea)
items.title: Approve modification to Interlocal Agreement 4600001073 for Child Care Gap Funding

items.evidence_text:
8. Receive a briefing on two reports produced by the Research & Planning Division 
of HHS: the Travis County Snapshot from the 2024 American Community 
Survey and the Fiscal Year 2025 Community Impact Report. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Receive briefing on HHS reports: Travis County Snapshot and FY2025 Community Impact

items.evidence_text:
9. Consider and take appropriate action on a request to approve Environmental 
Exemptions for the following projects/activities that will receive Community 
Development Block Grant (CDBG) and/or HOME funding during Program Year 
2025 (PY25) from HUD: 
    
  A. Program Year 2025 Administration & Planning (CDBG) 
  B. Program Year 2025 HOME Program 
(Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve Environmental Exemptions for PY25 CDBG and HOME projects

items.evidence_text:
10. Consider and take appropriate action on the following grant Letters of Intent, 
contracts and related special budgets, and permissions to continue: 
    
  A. Any other necessary grant applications, letters of support or grant awards 
attached to Commissioners Court backup for this Agenda item 
(Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider grant Letters of Intent, contracts, and permissions to continue

items.evidence_text:
11. Consider and take appropriate action on an appointment to the Strategic 
Housing Finance Corporation Board of Directors. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Appoint to Strategic Housing Finance Corporation Board

items.evidence_text:
12. Consider and take appropriate action on an appointment to the Animal Advisory 
Commission. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Appoint to Animal Advisory Commission

items.evidence_text:
13. Consider and take appropriate action on an appointment to the Sobering Center 
Board of Directors. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Appoint to Sobering Center Board of Directors

items.evidence_text: 14. Authorize the County Treasurer to invest County funds. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Authorize County Treasurer to invest County funds

items.evidence_text:
15. Consider and take appropriate action on budget amendments, transfers and 
discussions items, including but not limited to the following listed items, and any 
other necessary budget amendments and transfers attached to Commissioners 
Court backup for the Agenda item: 
    
  A. Request from Health and Human Services to establish a new budget in 
Afterschool Youth Enrichment Fund (0149) of $6,187.50 for revenue 
received by Health and Human Services related to the AmeriCorps 
Formula Grant for the CAPITAL AmeriCorps Project 
  B. Request from Health and Human Services to establish a New Budget of 
$4,300 for Revenue Received from Reliant Energy for the CARE 
Program 
  C. Request from Health and Human Services to establish a new budget in 
the Bluebonnet Electric Fund (2112) of $12,000 for revenue received by 
Health and Human Services related to the Bluebonnet Electric 
Cooperative 
  D. Request from the Travis County Sheriff's Office to add one vehicle to the 
County's fleet which will be purchased from the Office's Inmate Welfare 
Funds 
  E. Request from the Facilities Management Department (FMD) for 
$4,780,050 from a $13,040,000 Capital Improvement Plan Earmark 
against the Capital Acquisition Resources (CAR) Reserve to complete 
work on prioritized projects 
  F. Request from the Technology and Operations Department (TOPS) for a 
total of $703,831 from the Capital Acquisition Resources (CAR) Reserve 
that include $440,565 for the replacement and purchase of Automated 
External Defibrillators (AEDs) across Travis County facilities and the use 
of $263,266 from a $350,000 Earmark Against the CAR Reserve for 
Constable vehicle AEDs with the remaining Earmark of $86,734 to be 
released 
  G. Request from Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) within the Technology 
and Operations Department (TOPS) for $1,756,018 from the Fiscal Year 
2026 Catastrophic Loss Reserve within the Risk Management Fund 
(8955) to cover short-term liabilities for the remainder of the Fiscal Year 
  H. Request from the Juvenile Probation Department to reallocate $416,748 
from the air handler project that was included as part of the Fiscal Year 
2026 Adopted Budget and has a current balance of $534,748. These 
funds will now be used for critical fire panel safety repairs needed in 
Fiscal Year 2026. The Department will request these funds and 
additional funds as part of the Fiscal Year 2027 budget process to 
complete the air handler project 
(Commissioner Shea)
items.title: Consider budget amendments, transfers, and discussions including listed items A-H

items.evidence_text:
16. Receive briefing from PBO as directed by Commissioners Court on potential 
options for changes to Longevity Pay for Fiscal Year 2027. (Commissioner 
Shea)
items.title: Receive briefing on potential Longevity Pay changes for FY2027

items.evidence_text:
17. Consider and take appropriate action on the draft Travis County Foreign Trade 
Zone Policy and Guidelines for Consideration of Requests for Support for site 
activation. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider draft Foreign Trade Zone Policy and Guidelines

items.evidence_text: 18. Receive bids from County Purchasing Agent. (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Receive bids from County Purchasing Agent

items.evidence_text:
19. Approve contract award for professional consulting services, Slaughter Lane 
East Median Improvement, RFQ No. 2209-005-TL, in the amount of 
$164,191.76, to the most highly qualified respondent, Kimley-Horn and 
Associates, Inc. (Transportation & Natural Resources) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve contract award for Slaughter Lane East Median Improvement to Kimley-Horn

items.evidence_text:
20. Approve contract award for professional engineering services, Pace Bend Park 
Well Installation, RFQ No. 2209-005-TL, in the amount of $148,170.90, to the 
most highly qualified respondent, Martinez, Wright & Mendez, Inc., dba MWM 
DesignGroup, Inc. (Transportation & Natural Resources) (Commissioner 
Travillion)
items.title: Approve contract award for Pace Bend Park Well Installation to MWM DesignGroup

items.evidence_text:
21. Approve contract award for Generators Preventative Maintenance and 
Servicing, IFB No. 192-SM, to the following low bidders: 
    
  A. Contract No. 4400008764 with JPEC Services, LLC, in the amount of 
$184,435.00 
  B. Contract No. 4400008748 with Allegiant Generator Services NA LLC, in 
the amount of $15,920.00 (Juvenile Probation Department and Travis 
County Sheriff's Office)  
(Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve contract awards for Generators Preventative Maintenance to JPEC and Allegiant

items.evidence_text:
22. Approve Modification No. 3 to Contract No. 4400008126 with NIKSUN, Inc, in 
the amount of $96,889.00, for Network Analytics Tool. (Technology & 
Operations) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve Modification No. 3 to NIKSUN Network Analytics Tool contract

items.evidence_text:
23. Approve Modification No. 1, an assignment of Contract No. 4400002753, for 
Braker Lane North Roadway Extension, from CP&Y Inc. to STV Incorporated. 
(Transportation & Natural Resources) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve assignment of Braker Lane North Roadway Extension contract to STV

items.evidence_text:
24. Approve contract award for professional engineering services, 700 Lavaca 
Generator Replacement MEP, RFQ No. 2209-005-TL, in the amount of 
$122,000.00, to the most highly qualified respondent, IMEG Consultants Corp. 
(Facilities Management Department) (Commissioners Travillion)
items.title: Approve contract award for 700 Lavaca Generator Replacement MEP to IMEG

items.evidence_text:
25. Approve ratification of Modification No. 5 to Contract No. 4400006723 with 
Austin/Travis County Reentry Roundtable, in the amount of $35,000.00, for 
community engagement for formerly incarcerated persons. (Innovative Justice & 
Program Analysis) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Ratify Modification No. 5 to Reentry Roundtable contract

items.evidence_text:
26. Approve contract award for professional consulting services, Third Party Review 
of County Development and/or Transportation Permit Applications, RFQ No. 
2209-005-TL, in the amount of $500,000.00, to the most highly qualified 
respondent, SE3, LLC. (Transportation and Natural Resources) (Commissioner 
Travillion)
items.title: Approve contract award for Third Party Review of permits to SE3

items.evidence_text:
27. Approve Modification No. 1, an assignment of Contract No. 4400006626, for 
Appraisal Services, from Edward B Schulz & Co LLC dba Integra Realty 
Resources – Houston to North American Valuation and Consulting LLC dba 
Integra Realty Resources – Houston. (Transportation & Natural Resources) 
(Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve assignment of Appraisal Services contract to North American Valuation

items.evidence_text:
28. Approve contract award for car washing services, RFS 171-PE, as needed, to 
the sole respondent, The Car Wash Group, LLC dba Mr. Sharky’s Car Wash. 
(Transportation & Natural Resources) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve car washing services contract to Mr. Sharky’s Car Wash

items.evidence_text:
29. Approve order exempting the purchase of The WRAP Restraint System from 
Safe Restraints, Inc., as needed, from the competitive procurement process, 
pursuant to County Purchasing Act § 262.024(a)(2) and authorize Purchasing 
Agent to issue purchase orders. (Sheriff’s Office) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Exempt WRAP Restraint System purchase from competitive procurement

items.evidence_text:
30. Consider and take appropriate action on the following Personnel Amendments: 
    
  A. Routine Personnel Actions 
  B. Non-Routine Personnel Actions 
(Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Consider Personnel Amendments (Routine and Non-Routine)

items.evidence_text:
31. Consider and take appropriate action on the annual approved County Holiday 
Schedule, effective October 1, 2026, through December 31, 2027. 
(Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve annual County Holiday Schedule FY2027

items.evidence_text:
32. Consider and take appropriate action on a license agreement with Texas Law 
Austin for their Summer Social Event on June 2, 2026, from 3:00pm – 8:00pm, 
on the 12th floor at the Civil and Family Courts Facilities, located at 1700 
Guadalupe Street, Austin, Texas 78701. (Commissioner Howard)
items.title: Approve license agreement with Texas Law Austin for summer event

items.evidence_text:
33. Consider and take appropriate action regarding a lease with the Health and 
Human Services Commission for Travis County to use 1,183 square feet in 
Building 784 of the Austin State Hospital Campus, located at 4110 Guadalupe 
Street in Austin, Texas. Facilities Management is requesting to have the 
Commissioner’s Court delegate authority to approve yearly renewals to the 
Director of Facilities Management to sign subsequent site-specific environmental 
reviews. (Commissioner Shea)
items.title: Consider lease with HHSC for Austin State Hospital space and delegate renewals

items.evidence_text:
34. Consider and take appropriate action to approve the allocation of office space at 
the Travis County Administration Building, 700 Lavaca, Austin, Texas 78701 as 
follows: 
    
  A. Commissioner of Precinct 1 to move from Suite 2.200 on the 2nd floor 
and be allocated space in Suite 1510 on the 15th floor 
  B. Commissioner of Precinct 4 to move from Suite 1510 on the 15th floor 
and be allocated space in Suite 2.200 on the 2nd floor 
(Judge Brown & Commissioner Traviliion)
items.title: Approve office space allocation swap for Precinct 1 and 4 Commissioners

items.evidence_text:
35. Consider and take appropriate action on the Amended Vehicle Replacement 
Policy. (Commissioner Shea)
items.title: Consider Amended Vehicle Replacement Policy

items.evidence_text:
36. Consider and take appropriate action regarding a request to use a Cash 
Security Agreement for environmental fiscal security for AAA Storage Priem 
Lane Phase Two (Gattis School), in Precinct One. (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Consider Cash Security Agreement for AAA Storage environmental fiscal security

items.evidence_text:
37. Consider and take appropriate action on the Fifth Amendment to the 
Construction Agreement between Rastegar Related Fund Management Infinity 
Park Property Owner L, RPC F1 Once LLC, and Travis County for the McAngus 
Industrial Development project, in Precinct Four. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider Fifth Amendment to McAngus Industrial Development construction agreement

items.evidence_text:
38. 
Approve setting a public hearing on July 7, 2026, regarding a request to 
authorize the filing of an instrument to vacate a public utility easement located 
along the lot lines of Lots 408 & 873, Apache Shores Section 2, a subdivision in 
Precinct Three. (Commissioner Howard)
items.title: Set public hearing on vacating utility easement in Apache Shores Section 2

items.evidence_text:
39. Consider and take appropriate action on the Construction and Traffic Mitigation 
Agreement between Sunfield Development LLC, Sunfield Investments LLC, and 
Travis County for traffic mitigation associated with the proposed Sunfield 
development, in Precinct Four. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider Sunfield Development Construction and Traffic Mitigation Agreement

items.evidence_text:
40. Receive briefing and take appropriate action regarding Travis County security 
and information security issues.1,4 & 6 (Commissioner Travillion & Howard)
items.title: Receive briefing on Travis County security and information security issues

items.evidence_text:
41. Receive update on IJPA County Executive Recruitment in executive session.1&3 
(Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Receive update on IJPA County Executive Recruitment in executive session

items.evidence_text:
42. Receive legal briefing and take appropriate action on letter of intent for solar 
leases with PowerFin Partners.1&2 (Judge Brown)
items.title: Receive legal briefing on solar leases letter of intent with PowerFin Partners

items.evidence_text: ADJOURN
items.title: Adjourn

items.evidence_text: CALL TO ORDER
items.title: Call to Order of Commissioners Court

items.evidence_text:
1. Approve a proclamation recognizing the week of July 6 - 10, 2026 as Summer 
Learning Week in Travis County. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve Summer Learning Week proclamation

items.evidence_text: 2. Approve payment of claims by the County Treasurer. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve payment of claims by County Treasurer

items.evidence_text:
3. Receive the Travis County Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and 
Popular Annual Financial Report (PAFR) for the fiscal year ended September 
30, 2025. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Receive Annual Comprehensive and Popular Financial Reports

items.evidence_text:
4. Consider and take appropriate action regarding the following: 
    
  A. Outdoor burning in the unincorporated areas of Travis County 
  B. County response to natural disaster or other emergencies, including but 
not limited to necessary measures and actions related to the disaster or 
emergency, including Travis County’s response, operations, policies, 
emergency assistance, agreements, preparedness for future flood events 
and other disasters, and measures necessary to preserve public health 
and safety and rehabilitation of property, and applicable orders, 
declarations or resolutions, and authorization for expenditure of funds 
and contracts related to disaster response, preparedness and recovery 
efforts 
(Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider action on outdoor burning and emergency response

items.evidence_text:
5. Consider and take appropriate action to approve a second budget revision 
request from a Supportive Housing Subrecipient, Mobile Loaves & Fishes, 
reflected in the Subaward for Affordable Housing for the Homeless, Contract No. 
4400006882. (Commissioner Howard)
items.title: Approve budget revision for Mobile Loaves & Fishes supportive housing

items.evidence_text:
6. Consider and take appropriate action on the following grant Letters of Intent, 
contracts and related special budgets, and permissions to continue: 
    
  A. Application from the Travis County Juvenile Probation Department for the 
2027 Restorative Justice and Victim Services Program solicited by the 
Texas Bar Foundation 
  B. Application from the Travis County Juvenile Probation Department for the 
2027-2028 Discretionary State Aid Residential Projects solicited by the 
Texas Juvenile Justice Department 
  C. Amendment from Travis County Health and Human Services for the 
AmeriCorps Seniors Programs Grant Agreement  
  D. Award agreement from the Corporation for National and Community 
Services for the AmeriCorps Retired and Senior Volunteer Program 
within Health & Human Services 
  E. Any other necessary grant applications, letters of support or grant awards 
attached to Commissioners Court backup for this Agenda item 
(Judge Brown)
items.title: Consider grant letters of intent and contracts for juvenile probation and AmeriCorps

items.evidence_text:
7. Consider and take appropriate action on a comment letter for proposed changes 
to the Regulation for Federal Financial Assistance (docket OMB-2026-0034). 
(Judge Brown)
items.title: Comment letter on Federal Financial Assistance Regulation

items.evidence_text:
8. Lease Agreement with Austin Ridge Bible Church for Travis County Sheriff's 
Office COBRA Graduation Ceremonies. (Commissioner Morales)
items.title: Lease agreement with Austin Ridge Bible Church for COBRA graduations

items.evidence_text: 9. Authorize the County Treasurer to invest County funds. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Authorize County Treasurer to invest funds

items.evidence_text:
10. Consider and take appropriate action on budget amendments, transfers and 
discussions items, including but not limited to the following listed items, and any 
other necessary budget amendments and transfers attached to Commissioners 
Court backup for the Agenda item: 
    
  A. Request from Health and Human Services to Establish a New Budget of 
$17,288.20 comprised of $4,769.10 in Fund 2034 for the Texas Gas 
Service – Share the Warmth Program and $12,519.10 in Fund 2112 for 
the Bluebonnet Electric Cooperative 
  B. Request from Transportation and Natural Resources to use up to $2,860 
of existing internal departmental resources to purchase food/beverages 
for the 3rd Annual Road and Bridge Equipment Rodeo and Annual 
Department-Wide TNR Safety and Employee Recognition Event 
  C. Request from the County Clerk’s Office to internally fund the creation of 
an Elections Administrator Assistant (1.0 FTE) to address increased 
workload within the Elections Division at a cost of $58,804 for the 
remainder of Fiscal Year 2026, with the full year annualized cost of 
$152,546 that will be funded within existing resources in the Fiscal Year 
2027 Preliminary Budget 
  D. Request from the Planning and Budget Office for $25,000 from the 
Allocated Reserve to fund an update to the analysis related to the 
collection of venue tax under Chapter 334 related to Travis County 
Exposition Center 
(Commissioner Shea)
items.title: Consider budget amendments and transfers for multiple departments

items.evidence_text:
11. Consider and take appropriate action on a request from the Visit Austin for the 
County to act as the Endorsing County for and to appoint the Austin Sports 
Commission as its exclusive designee and Local Organizing Committee for an 
application to participate in the Texas Events Trust Fund with respect to the 
2026 Good Good Golf Championship to be held at the grounds and facilities of 
the Omni Barton Creek Resort and Spa, Fazio Canyons Course, in Travis 
County on November 9-15, 2026. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Endorse Visit Austin and appoint Sports Commission for golf championship trust fund

items.evidence_text:
12. Consider and take appropriate action on a resolution approving and authorizing 
a financing agreement for the Lagos Reserve Public Improvement District. (This 
item will be taken into executive session under the Consultation with Attorney 
exception, Texas Government Code §551.071) (Commissioner Travillion).
items.title: Resolution for Lagos Reserve PID financing agreement (exec session consulted)

items.evidence_text: 13. Receive bids from County Purchasing Agent. (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Receive bids from County Purchasing Agent

items.evidence_text:
14. Approve Modification No. 3 to Contract No. 4400007201 with Square One 
Consultants, Inc., in the deductive amount of $461,094.00, for Supportive 
Housing Construction Compliance and Monitoring Services. (Health and Human 
Services) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve Modification No. 3 to Square One Consultants contract

items.evidence_text:
15. Approve contract award for consulting services for U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service 
(USFWS) Regional Permit and Balcones Canyonlands Conservation Plan 
(BCCP), RFS No. 145-JH, in the amount of $2,048,982.00, to the highest-
ranked respondent, ICF Environmental, Inc. (Transportation & Natural 
Resources) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Award consulting contract for USFWS permit and BCCP to ICF Environmental

items.evidence_text:
16. Declare items surplus property and sell at public auction pursuant to Local 
Government Code, Section 263.152(a)(1). (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Declare surplus property for public auction

items.evidence_text:
17. Approve Modification No. 9 to Contract No. 4400006451 with Alliant Insurance 
Services, Inc., in the amount of $128,075.93, for cyber security insurance broker 
of record services. (Technology & Operations) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve Modification No. 9 to Alliant Insurance contract

items.evidence_text:
18. Approve Modification No. 2 to Contract No. 4400007807 with Mend 
Collaborative, Inc., in the amount of $70,500.00, for the Travis County Parks 
Comprehensive Plan. (Transportation and Natural Resources) (Commissioner 
Travillion)
items.title: Approve Modification No. 2 to Mend Collaborative parks plan contract

items.evidence_text:
19. Approve Modification No. 11 to Contract 4400001439 with Medicalistics, LLC., in 
the amount of $10,980.00, for Electronic Medical Records Software and 
Maintenance. (TCSO) (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve Modification No. 11 to Medicalistics EMR contract

items.evidence_text:
20. Reject all proposals received for RFP No. 129-LC, for Accounting Software. (Tax 
Office) (Commissioners Travillion)
items.title: Reject proposals for Accounting Software RFP

items.evidence_text:
21. Approve Modification No. 3 to Contract No. 4400007202 with Guidehouse, Inc., 
in the deductive amount of $614,252.00, for Supportive Housing Construction 
Compliance and Monitoring Services. (Health and Human Services) 
(Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Approve Modification No. 3 to Guidehouse supportive housing contract

items.evidence_text:
22. Consider and take appropriate action on the following Personnel Amendments: 
    
  A. Routine Personnel Actions 
  B. Non-Routine Personnel Actions 
(Commissioners Travillion & Morales)
items.title: Personnel amendments routine and non-routine

items.evidence_text:
23. Consider and take appropriate action regarding the approval of the license 
agreement between Travis County and Great Promise for American Indians to 
use a portion of the grounds at the Exposition Center on November 20 and 21, 
2026 for Austin Powwow and Native Market, waiving the related facility rental 
fees. (Judge Brown)
items.title: License agreement with Great Promise for American Indians at Exposition Center

items.evidence_text:
24. Consider and take appropriate action on the Construction and Traffic Mitigation 
Agreement between Lund Farm Investment LLC, a Texas limited liability 
company, and Travis County, for traffic mitigation associated with the proposed 
Lund Road Farms Development, in Precinct One. (Commissioner Travillion)
items.title: Construction and traffic mitigation agreement with Lund Farm Investment

items.evidence_text:
25. Consider and take appropriate action on a Subdivision Construction Agreement 
between Sunfield Investments LLC, Sunfield Municipal Utility District No.2, and 
Travis County for the construction of street and drainage improvements for 
Bright Light Boulevard Segment 3, a proposed subdivision, in Precinct Four. 
(Commissioner Morales)
items.title: Subdivision construction agreement Sunfield MUD No.2 Bright Light Blvd Seg3

items.evidence_text:
26. Consider and take appropriate action on a Subdivision Construction Agreement 
between Sunfield Investments LLC, Sunfield Municipal Utility District No.3, and 
Travis County for the construction of street and drainage improvements for 
Bright Light Boulevard Segment 2, a proposed subdivision, in Precinct Four. 
(Commissioner Morales)
items.title: Subdivision construction agreement Sunfield MUD No.3 Bright Light Blvd Seg2

items.evidence_text:
27. Approve the minutes for the May 5, May 12, and May 19, 2026, Voting 
Sessions. (Judge Brown)
items.title: Approve minutes of May 2026 voting sessions

items.evidence_text:
28. Receive briefing and take appropriate action regarding Travis County security 
and information security issues.1,4 & 6 (Commissioner Travillion & Howard)
items.title: Executive session briefing on security and information security

items.evidence_text:
29. Receive legal briefing and take appropriate action regarding Cause No. D-1-GN-
25-009885, Shane Saum and Jeffery Bowen vs. The Travis County 
Commissioners Court, Andy Brown, Jeffrey Travillion, Brigid Shea, Ann Howard, 
and Margaret Gomez, All in Their Official Capacities; In the 98th Judicial District 
Court, Travis County, Texas.1 (Judge Brown)
items.title: Executive session legal briefing on Saum and Bowen lawsuit

items.evidence_text:
30. Receive legal briefing and take appropriate action regarding Travis County 
Supportive Housing Initiative related to ANE Webberville, LLC, Contract No. 
4400007226.1 (Commissioner Howard)
items.title: Executive session briefing on Supportive Housing ANE Webberville contract

items.evidence_text: ADJOURN
items.title: Adjourn Commissioners Court

items.evidence_text: ADJOURN
items.title: Adjourn Travis County Development Authority

items.evidence_text:
1. Consider and take appropriate action on a resolution approving and authorizing 
a financing agreement for the Lagos Reserve Public Improvement District. 
(Commissioner Traviilion)
items.title: Resolution for Lagos Reserve PID financing agreement (Development Authority)

items.evidence_text:
95. A public hearing to receive comments to amend the City of Dallas’ Thoroughfare Plan to 
change the dimensional classifications of (1) Peterson Lane from Preston Road to 
Unnamed FN6 from a special two-lane undivided collector (SPCL 2U) roadway with 
parking within 69-feet of right-of-way and 44-feet of pavement to a special four-lane 
divided collector (SPCL 4D) roadway within 70-feet of right-of-way and 45-feet of 
pavement; (2) Peterson Lane from Unnamed FN6 to a local street Road 1 from a 
special two-lane undivided collector (SPCL 2U) roadway with parking within 69-feet of 
right-of-way and 44-feet of pavement to a special two-lane undivided (SPCL 2U) 
roadway with parking within 65-feet of right-of-way and 40-feet of pavement; and (3) 
Peterson Lane from Road 1 to Unnamed FN5 from a special two-lane undivided 
collector (SPCL 2U) roadway with parking within 69-feet of right-of-way and 44-feet of 
pavement to a special one-lane couplet (SPCL 1 CPLT) Peterson East and Peterson 
West with one-travel-lane and one-parking-lane in each direction within 38.5 feet of 
right-of-way and 26-feet of pavement; and at the close of the hearing, authorize an 
ordinance implementing the change - Financing: No cost consideration to the City
items.title: Public hearing and ordinance amending Thoroughfare Plan for Peterson Lane

items.evidence_text:
96. A public hearing to receive comments to amend the City of Dallas’ Thoroughfare Plan to 
change the dimensional classifications of (1) Beckley Avenue from IH-30 to Greenbriar 
Lane from a six-lane divided roadway [M-6-D(A)] within 100-feet of right-of-way to a 
special six-lane undivided (SPCL 6U) roadway with a center turn lane, a cycle track and 
recommended off-peak parking within 100-feet of right-of-way; (2) Beckley Avenue from 
Greenbriar Lane to Colorado Boulevard from a six-lane divided roadway [M-6-D(A)] 
within 100-feet of right-of-way to a special six-lane divided (SPCL 6D) roadway with a 
cycle track within 100-feet of right-of-way and 72 feet of pavement; (3) Beckley Avenue 
from Colorado Boulevard to Zang Boulevard from a six-lane divided roadway [M-6-D(A)] 
within 100-feet of right-of-way to a special six-lane divided (SPCL 6D) roadway with 
cycle track within 88-feet of right-of-way and 64 feet of pavement; (4) Zang Boulevard 
from Jefferson/Houston Viaduct to Oakenwald Street from a six-lane divided roadway 
[M-6-D(A)] within 100-feet of right-of-way to a special four-lane divided (SPCL 4D) 
roadway with protected bicycle facility and a dedicated streetcar lane within 100-feet of 
right-of-way and 80-feet of pavement; (5) Zang Boulevard from Oakenwald Street to 
Beckley Avenue from a six-lane divided roadway [M-6-D(A)] within 100-feet of right-of-
way to a special four-lane divided (SPCL 4D) roadway with bicycle lanes within 100-feet 
of right-of-way and 80-feet of pavement; and (6) Zang Boulevard from Beckley Avenue 
to Davis Street from a six-lane divided roadway [M-6-D(A)] within 100-feet of right-of-
way to a special four-lane divided (SPCL 4D) roadway with parking in 100-feet of right-
of-way with 72-feet of pavement; and at the close of the hearing, authorize an ordinance 
implementing the change - Financing: No cost consideration to the City
items.title: Public hearing and ordinance amending Thoroughfare Plan for Beckley and Zang

City of Denton, Cause No. 14-08933-431 currently pending in the 431st District Court of Denton County regarding hydraulic fracturing where a public discussion of these legal matters would conflict with the duty of the City’s attorneys under the Texas Disciplinary Rules of Professional Conduct of the State Bar of Texas.
